description.en: The Julich-Brain atlas divides the thalamus into about thirty cytoarchitectonic nuclei, grouped as anterior (AM, AV), medial (MD, Pv, CM, Pf, Li), ventral (VA, VLA, VLP, VIM, VM, VPL, VPM, VPi), lateral (LD, LP), pulvinar (PUa, PUm, PUl, PUi), intralaminar (CL) and reticular (Rt), with the zona incerta beneath.
description.uz: Julich-Brain atlasi talamusni ~30 ta sitoarxitektonik yadroga bo'ladi: oldingi (AM, AV), medial (MD, Pv, CM, Pf, Li), ventral (VA, VLA, VLP, VIM, VM, VPL, VPM, VPi), lateral (LD, LP), pulvinar (PUa, PUm, PUl, PUi), intralaminar (CL) va retikulyar (Rt), ostida zona incerta.

role.en: Each nucleus relays a specific input to a specific cortical area: VPL/VPM carry body and face sensation to the postcentral gyrus; VA/VLA receive the basal ganglia and VLP/VIM the cerebellum for the motor cortex; MD serves the prefrontal cortex (working memory, emotion); AV/AM belong to the Papez memory circuit; the pulvinar directs visual attention; Rt is a GABAergic shell that gates all the others.
role.uz: Har yadro muayyan kirishni muayyan po'stloq maydoniga uzatadi: VPL/VPM tana va yuz sezgisini postcentral burmaga; VA/VLA bazal yadrolardan, VLP/VIM miyachadan harakat po'stlog'iga; MD prefrontal po'stloqqa xizmat qiladi (ishchi xotira, emotsiya); AV/AM Papez xotira zanjiriga kiradi; pulvinar ko'rish diqqatini yo'naltiradi; Rt — qolgan barchasini boshqaruvchi GABAergik qobiq.

clinical.en: VIM is the target of DBS and focused ultrasound for tremor; VPL/VPM infarcts cause hemianaesthesia and central pain; MD and anterior nuclei damage (Korsakoff, artery of Percheron infarct) causes amnesia.
clinical.uz: VIM — tremorda DBS va fokuslangan ultratovush nishoni; VPL/VPM infarktlari gemianesteziya va markaziy og'riq beradi; MD va oldingi yadrolar zararlanishi (Korsakov, Percheron arteriyasi infarkti) amneziya beradi.

description.en: The lateral (CGL) and medial (CGM) geniculate bodies at the back of the thalamus.
description.uz: Talamus orqasidagi lateral (CGL) va medial (CGM) tizzasimon tanalar.

role.en: CGL relays vision to the calcarine cortex; CGM relays hearing to Heschl's gyrus.
role.uz: CGL ko'rishni kalkarin po'stloqqa, CGM eshitishni Heshl burmasiga uzatadi.

clinical.en: CGL lesions cause homonymous hemianopia.
clinical.uz: CGL zararlanishi gomonim gemianopsiya beradi.

description.en: The subthalamic nucleus (STN) as mapped cytoarchitectonically.
description.uz: Sitoarxitektonik xaritalangan subtalamik yadro (STN).

role.en: Excitatory node of the indirect basal ganglia pathway that brakes movement.
role.uz: Harakatni to'xtatuvchi bilvosita bazal yadro yo'lining qo'zg'atuvchi tuguni.

clinical.en: Main DBS target in Parkinson disease; lesion → hemiballismus.
clinical.uz: Parkinson kasalligida asosiy DBS nishoni; zararlanishi → gemiballizm.

description.en: Julich-Brain divides the amygdala into the laterobasal group (LB), the centromedial group (CM), the superficial group (SF, including the cortical nuclei), and transitional zones: the amygdalostriatal transition (Astr), the interfascicular (IF), medial (MF) and ventromedial (VTM) fibre-rich areas.
description.uz: Julich-Brain amigdalani laterobazal guruh (LB), sentromedial guruh (CM), yuzaki guruh (SF, po'stloq yadrolari bilan) va o'tish zonalariga bo'ladi: amigdalostriatal o'tish (Astr), interfassikulyar (IF), medial (MF) va ventromedial (VTM) tolaga boy sohalar.

role.en: LB receives sensory and prefrontal input and learns which cues predict threat; CM is the output that triggers freezing, autonomic arousal and stress hormones via the hypothalamus and brainstem; SF processes smell and social signals.
role.uz: LB sezgi va prefrontal kirishlarni olib qaysi belgilar xavfni bildirishini o'rganadi; CM — gipotalamus va miya ustuni orqali qotib qolish, vegetativ qo'zg'alish va stress gormonlarini ishga tushiruvchi chiqish; SF hid va ijtimoiy signallarni qayta ishlaydi.

clinical.en: Hyperactivity in anxiety and PTSD; the medial temporal seizure focus; bilateral damage → Klüver–Bucy syndrome.
clinical.uz: Xavotir va PTSDda giperfaollik; medial chakka tutqanoq o'chog'i; ikki tomonlama zararlanish → Klüver–Bucy sindromi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2005 — Cytoarchitectonic mapping of the human amygdala

description.en: The hippocampal formation mapped by cytoarchitecture: the cornu Ammonis sectors CA1, CA2 and CA3, the dentate gyrus (DG), the hippocampal-amygdaloid transition area (HATA), the subicular complex (Subc) and the transsubiculum (TrS).
description.uz: Sitoarxitektonika bo'yicha xaritalangan hippokampal formatsiya: Ammon shoxi sektorlari CA1, CA2, CA3, tishsimon burma (DG), hippokamp-amigdala o'tish sohasi (HATA), subikulyar kompleks (Subc) va transsubikulum (TrS).

role.en: The trisynaptic memory circuit: entorhinal cortex → DG → CA3 → CA1 → subiculum → back to cortex. DG separates similar memories (pattern separation), CA3 completes partial cues (pattern completion), CA1 compares and outputs, the subiculum is the main exit.
role.uz: Uch sinapsli xotira zanjiri: entorinal po'stloq → DG → CA3 → CA1 → subikulum → yana po'stloqqa. DG o'xshash xotiralarni ajratadi, CA3 qisman belgilardan to'liq xotirani tiklaydi, CA1 solishtirib chiqaradi, subikulum asosiy chiqish.

clinical.en: CA1 (Sommer's sector) dies first in hypoxia and in hippocampal sclerosis; the subiculum/CA1 border is the earliest Alzheimer tangle site; bilateral loss → anterograde amnesia.
clinical.uz: CA1 (Sommer sektori) gipoksiya va hippokampal sklerozda birinchi nobud bo'ladi; subikulum/CA1 chegarasi Alzheimer chigallarining eng erta joyi; ikki tomonlama yo'qolishi → anterograd amneziya.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2005 — Cytoarchitectonic mapping of the hippocampal region

description.en: The entorhinal cortex (EC, Brodmann area 28) on the anterior parahippocampal gyrus, the main interface between the neocortex and the hippocampus.
description.uz: Oldingi parahippokampal burmadagi entorinal po'stloq (EC, Brodmann 28) — neokorteks bilan hippokamp orasidagi asosiy interfeys.

role.en: Funnels sensory and associative information into the hippocampus via the perforant path and returns consolidated memories; contains grid cells for spatial navigation.
role.uz: Sezgi va assotsiativ axborotni perforant yo'l orqali hippokampga yo'naltiradi va mustahkamlangan xotiralarni qaytaradi; fazoviy yo'nalish uchun 'panjara hujayralari'ni o'z ichiga oladi.

clinical.en: The very first site of neurofibrillary tangles in Alzheimer disease (Braak stage I).
clinical.uz: Alzheimer kasalligida neyrofibrillyar chigallarning eng birinchi joyi (Braak I bosqichi).

description.en: Cholinergic cell groups under the striatum: Ch1–3 (medial septum and diagonal band) and Ch4 (nucleus basalis of Meynert), plus the bed nucleus of the stria terminalis (BST), the olfactory tubercle (Tu) and the terminal islands (TuTi).
description.uz: Striatum ostidagi xolinergik hujayra guruhlari: Ch1–3 (medial septum va diagonal tutam) va Ch4 (Meynert bazal yadrosi), shuningdek stria terminalis yadrosi (BST), hidlov do'ngligi (Tu) va terminal orolchalar (TuTi).

role.en: Ch4 is the main source of acetylcholine to the whole cortex (attention, learning); Ch1–3 supply the hippocampus (memory, theta rhythm); BST mediates sustained anxiety.
role.uz: Ch4 butun po'stloq uchun asetilxolinning asosiy manbai (diqqat, o'rganish); Ch1–3 hippokampni ta'minlaydi (xotira, teta ritmi); BST uzoq davom etuvchi xavotirni ta'minlaydi.

clinical.en: Loss of nucleus basalis neurons underlies the cholinergic deficit of Alzheimer disease — the rationale for cholinesterase-inhibitor drugs.
clinical.uz: Bazal yadro neyronlarining yo'qolishi Alzheimer kasalligidagi xolinergik yetishmovchilikning asosi — xolinesteraza ingibitorlari qo'llanishining sababi.

description.en: The ventral striatum: lateral and medial nucleus accumbens (AcbL, AcbM) and the fundus regions of the caudate (FuCd) and putamen (FuP).
description.uz: Ventral striatum: lateral va medial nucleus accumbens (AcbL, AcbM) hamda kaudat (FuCd) va putamen (FuP) tubi sohalari.

role.en: The reward centre: dopamine from the ventral tegmental area signals reward prediction here, driving motivation, pleasure and habit formation.
role.uz: Mukofot markazi: ventral tegmental sohadan keluvchi dofamin bu yerda mukofot bashoratini bildirib motivatsiya, huzur va odat shakllanishini boshqaradi.

clinical.en: Central to addiction; a DBS target under study for depression and OCD.
clinical.uz: Giyohvandlikning markazi; depressiya va OKBda o'rganilayotgan DBS nishoni.

description.en: The ventral extension of the globus pallidus beneath the anterior commissure.
description.uz: Oldingi komissura ostidagi globus pallidusning ventral davomi.

role.en: Output of the ventral striatum to the thalamus: converts motivation into action and encodes 'liking'.
role.uz: Ventral striatumning talamusga chiqishi: motivatsiyani harakatga aylantiradi va 'yoqtirish'ni kodlaydi.

clinical.en: Part of the reward circuitry altered in addiction.
clinical.uz: Giyohvandlikda o'zgaradigan mukofot zanjirining qismi.

description.en: Midbrain nuclei mapped by Julich-Brain: the substantia nigra pars compacta (SNC) and pars reticulata (SNR), and the magnocellular (NRm) and parvocellular (NRp) parts of the red nucleus.
description.uz: Julich-Brain xaritalagan o'rta miya yadrolari: substantia nigra pars compacta (SNC) va pars reticulata (SNR), qizil yadroning magnotsellyulyar (NRm) va parvotsellyulyar (NRp) qismlari.

role.en: SNC dopamine drives the striatum; SNR is a basal ganglia output to the thalamus and superior colliculus; NRm gives the rubrospinal tract, NRp relays cerebellar output to the olive.
role.uz: SNC dofamini striatumni boshqaradi; SNR — bazal yadrolarning talamus va yuqori do'nglikka chiqishi; NRm rubrospinal traktni beradi, NRp miyacha chiqishini zaytunga uzatadi.

clinical.en: SNC degeneration = Parkinson disease; red nucleus lesions cause Holmes tremor.
clinical.uz: SNC degeneratsiyasi = Parkinson kasalligi; qizil yadro zararlanishi Holmes tremori beradi.

description.en: The deep cerebellar nuclei: dorsal and ventral dentate (Ndentd, Ndentv), interposed (Ninterp; emboliform + globose) and fastigial (Nfast).
description.uz: Miyachaning chuqur yadrolari: dorsal va ventral tishsimon (Ndentd, Ndentv), oraliq (Ninterp; emboliform + globoz) va fastigial (Nfast).

role.en: All cerebellar output leaves through them: the dentate → thalamus → motor and prefrontal cortex (planning, timing); interposed → red nucleus (limb coordination); fastigial → vestibular nuclei and reticular formation (balance, gait).
role.uz: Miyachaning barcha chiqishi ular orqali: tishsimon → talamus → harakat va prefrontal po'stloq (rejalashtirish, vaqt); oraliq → qizil yadro (oyoq-qo'l muvofiqligi); fastigial → vestibulyar yadrolar va retikulyar formatsiya (muvozanat, yurish).

clinical.en: Dentate injury causes intention tremor and dysmetria; the dentate-rubro-olivary triangle is disrupted in palatal tremor. Cerebellar mutism after posterior fossa surgery in children involves the dentate outflow.
clinical.uz: Tishsimon yadro jarohati intension tremor va dismetriya beradi; tanglay tremorida dentato-rubro-olivar uchburchak buziladi. Bolalarda orqa chuqurcha jarrohligidan keyingi miyacha mutizmi tishsimon yadro chiqishi bilan bog'liq.

description.en: The precentral gyrus mapped cytoarchitectonically: areas 4a and 4p (primary motor cortex) on the anterior wall of the central sulcus, and the premotor areas 6d1–6d3 (dorsal), 6v1–6v3 (ventral) and 6r1 in front of them.
description.uz: Sitoarxitektonik xaritalangan precentral burma: markaziy egat oldingi devoridagi 4a va 4p maydonlar (birlamchi harakat po'stlog'i) hamda ular oldidagi premotor 6d1–6d3 (dorsal), 6v1–6v3 (ventral) va 6r1 maydonlari.

role.en: Area 4 generates the corticospinal command for movement (4p is more sensitive to attention and force); area 6 plans and prepares movements — dorsal premotor for reaching under visual guidance, ventral premotor for grasping and mirror-neuron-like action understanding.
role.uz: 4-maydon harakat uchun kortikospinal buyruqni hosil qiladi (4p diqqat va kuchga sezgirroq); 6-maydon harakatni rejalashtiradi va tayyorlaydi — dorsal premotor ko'rish nazoratida qo'l uzatish, ventral premotor ushlash va 'ko'zgu neyron' tarzida harakatni tushunish uchun.

clinical.en: Area 4 lesions → contralateral weakness with loss of fine finger movement; premotor lesions → apraxia and difficulty using visual cues to guide movement.
clinical.uz: 4-maydon zararlanishi → qarama-qarshi tomonda kuchsizlik va barmoqlarning nozik harakati yo'qolishi; premotor zararlanish → apraksiya va harakatni ko'rish belgilari bilan boshqarishda qiyinchilik.

sources.title: Geyer et al. 1996 — Two different areas within the primary motor cortex of man

description.en: The primary somatosensory cortex on the postcentral gyrus: area 3a in the depth of the central sulcus, 3b on its posterior wall and area 1 on the crown.
description.uz: Postcentral burmadagi birlamchi somatosensor po'stloq: markaziy egat tubidagi 3a, orqa devoridagi 3b va cho'qqisidagi 1-maydon.

role.en: 3a receives muscle-spindle (proprioceptive) input; 3b is the main cortical map of touch on the skin; area 1 processes texture; together they build the sensory homunculus.
role.uz: 3a mushak duki (proprioseptiv) kirishini oladi; 3b terining sezgi xaritasi; 1-maydon tuzilmani (teksturani) qayta ishlaydi; birgalikda sensor gomunkulusni hosil qiladi.

clinical.en: Lesions cause cortical sensory loss on the opposite side: impaired two-point discrimination, graphaesthesia and stereognosis.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi qarama-qarshi tomonda kortikal sensor yetishmovchilik beradi: ikki nuqtani farqlash, grafesteziya va stereognozning buzilishi.

sources.title: Geyer et al. 1999 — Areas 3a, 3b and 1 of human primary somatosensory cortex

description.en: Area 2, on the posterior wall of the postcentral sulcus.
description.uz: Postcentral egat orqa devoridagi 2-maydon.

role.en: Integrates touch and joint position to represent the shape and size of objects held in the hand.
role.uz: Sezgi va bo'g'im holatini birlashtirib qo'ldagi narsaning shakli va o'lchamini ifodalaydi.

clinical.en: Lesions cause astereognosis — inability to recognise objects by touch.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi astereognoz beradi — narsalarni sezib tanimaslik.

sources.title: Grefkes et al. 2001 — Human somatosensory area 2

description.en: The superior parietal lobule: areas 5L, 5M, 5Ci, 7A, 7P, 7M and 7PC.
description.uz: Yuqori tepa bo'lakchasi: 5L, 5M, 5Ci, 7A, 7P, 7M va 7PC maydonlari.

role.en: Combines vision and body sense to guide reaching and to keep a map of where the limbs are in space; area 5 is somatosensory association cortex, area 7 visuomotor.
role.uz: Ko'rish va tana sezgisini birlashtirib qo'l uzatishni boshqaradi va oyoq-qo'llarning fazodagi o'rni xaritasini saqlaydi; 5-maydon somatosensor assotsiativ, 7-maydon vizuomotor po'stloq.

clinical.en: Bilateral lesions cause optic ataxia and Bálint syndrome; right lesions contribute to neglect.
clinical.uz: Ikki tomonlama zararlanish optik ataksiya va Balint sindromi beradi; o'ng tomon zararlanishi e'tiborsizlikka hissa qo'shadi.

sources.title: Scheperjans et al. 2008 — Human superior parietal cortex

description.en: Areas hIP1–hIP8 in the intraparietal sulcus.
description.uz: Tepa ichi egatidagi hIP1–hIP8 maydonlari.

role.en: Number sense and calculation (anterior IPS), eye-movement and attention control, and the visual guidance of grasping.
role.uz: Son hissi va hisoblash (oldingi IPS), ko'z harakati va diqqat boshqaruvi hamda ushlashni ko'rish orqali boshqarish.

clinical.en: Left IPS lesions cause acalculia; it is part of the dorsal attention network disrupted in neglect.
clinical.uz: Chap IPS zararlanishi akalkuliya beradi; e'tiborsizlikda buziladigan dorsal diqqat tarmog'ining qismi.

sources.title: Choi et al. 2006 — Cytoarchitectonic areas in the human intraparietal sulcus

description.en: The inferior parietal lobule divided into seven areas: PFop, PFt, PF, PFm, PFcm (supramarginal region) and PGa, PGp (angular region).
description.uz: Pastki tepa bo'lakchasi yetti maydonga bo'lingan: PFop, PFt, PF, PFm, PFcm (supramarginal soha) va PGa, PGp (angular soha).

role.en: Anterior (PF) areas: tool use, action understanding and phonological processing; posterior (PG) areas: reading, semantic memory, spatial attention and the default-mode network.
role.uz: Oldingi (PF) maydonlar: asbob ishlatish, harakatni tushunish va fonologik qayta ishlov; orqa (PG) maydonlar: o'qish, semantik xotira, fazoviy diqqat va default-mode tarmog'i.

clinical.en: Left: apraxia, Gerstmann syndrome, conduction aphasia; right: hemispatial neglect.
clinical.uz: Chap: apraksiya, Gerstmann sindromi, o'tkazuvchi afaziya; o'ng: gemispatial e'tiborsizlik.

sources.title: Caspers et al. 2006 — The human inferior parietal cortex

description.en: Areas SFG2, SFG3, SFG4 and 8d1, 8d2 on the superior frontal gyrus.
description.uz: Yuqori peshona burmasidagi SFG2, SFG3, SFG4 va 8d1, 8d2 maydonlari.

role.en: Working memory, planning and self-referential thought; area 8 contains the frontal eye fields for voluntary gaze shifts.
role.uz: Ishchi xotira, rejalashtirish va o'zi haqida fikrlash; 8-maydonda ixtiyoriy nigoh o'zgarishi uchun peshona ko'z maydonlari.

clinical.en: Lesions impair executive function; frontal eye field damage deviates the eyes toward the lesion.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi ijro funksiyalarini buzadi; peshona ko'z maydoni zararlansa ko'zlar o'choq tomonga og'adi.

description.en: Areas SFS1, SFS2 and 6d3 in the superior frontal sulcus.
description.uz: Yuqori peshona egatidagi SFS1, SFS2 va 6d3 maydonlari.

role.en: Spatial working memory and dorsal premotor planning.
role.uz: Fazoviy ishchi xotira va dorsal premotor rejalashtirish.

clinical.en: Part of the dorsolateral prefrontal circuit affected in executive dysfunction.
clinical.uz: Ijro disfunksiyasida ta'sirlanadigan dorsolateral prefrontal zanjirning qismi.

description.en: Areas MFG1, MFG2, MFG4, MFG5 and 8v1, 8v2 on the middle frontal gyrus — the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex.
description.uz: O'rta peshona burmasidagi MFG1, MFG2, MFG4, MFG5 va 8v1, 8v2 maydonlari — dorsolateral prefrontal po'stloq.

role.en: Working memory, cognitive control, rule switching and decision making.
role.uz: Ishchi xotira, kognitiv nazorat, qoidalarni almashtirish va qaror qabul qilish.

clinical.en: The rTMS target for depression; lesions cause dysexecutive syndrome.
clinical.uz: Depressiyada rTMS nishoni; zararlanishi dizeksekutiv sindrom beradi.

description.en: Areas IFS1–IFS4 and the inferior frontal junction areas IFJ1, IFJ2 in the inferior frontal sulcus.
description.uz: Pastki peshona egatidagi IFS1–IFS4 va pastki peshona tutashuvi IFJ1, IFJ2 maydonlari.

role.en: Cognitive control and task switching; the IFJ links language, working memory and attention.
role.uz: Kognitiv nazorat va vazifa almashtirish; IFJ til, ishchi xotira va diqqatni bog'laydi.

clinical.en: Involved in the frontal network for attention deficits after stroke.
clinical.uz: Insultdan keyingi diqqat yetishmovchiligining peshona tarmog'ida ishtirok etadi.

description.en: Areas 44 and 45 of the inferior frontal gyrus — Broca's region in the left hemisphere.
description.uz: Pastki peshona burmasining 44 va 45-maydonlari — chap yarim sharda Broka sohasi.

role.en: Area 44 handles the syntax and motor sequencing of speech; area 45 retrieves words and meanings; on the right they support prosody and inhibition.
role.uz: 44-maydon nutq sintaksisi va harakat ketma-ketligini, 45-maydon so'z va ma'nolarni chaqirishni boshqaradi; o'ng tomonda intonatsiya va tormozlashni ta'minlaydi.

clinical.en: Broca's aphasia; the region is mapped with awake stimulation before tumour surgery to protect speech.
clinical.uz: Broka afaziyasi; nutqni saqlash uchun o'sma jarrohligidan oldin uyg'oq stimulyatsiya bilan xaritalanadi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 1999 — Broca's region revisited

description.en: Areas Op5–Op10 of the frontal operculum, the cortex overhanging the insula in front of the central sulcus.
description.uz: Peshona operkulumining Op5–Op10 maydonlari — markaziy egat oldida insula ustiga osilib turuvchi po'stloq.

role.en: Taste (gustatory cortex), articulation and the control of swallowing; part of the ventral language network.
role.uz: Ta'm (gustator po'stloq), artikulyatsiya va yutishni boshqarish; ventral til tarmog'ining qismi.

clinical.en: Lesions cause dysarthria and apraxia of speech.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi dizartriya va nutq apraksiyasini beradi.

description.en: Areas OP1–OP4 of the parietal operculum, the upper bank of the lateral fissure behind the central sulcus.
description.uz: Tepa operkulumining OP1–OP4 maydonlari — markaziy egat orqasida lateral egatning yuqori qirg'og'i.

role.en: The secondary somatosensory cortex (S2): touch from both sides of the body, pain, and tactile learning; OP2 is the core vestibular cortex.
role.uz: Ikkilamchi somatosensor po'stloq (S2): tananing ikkala tomonidan sezgi, og'riq va taktil o'rganish; OP2 — vestibulyar po'stloqning o'zagi.

clinical.en: Involved in chronic pain and in vestibular symptoms after stroke.
clinical.uz: Surunkali og'riq va insultdan keyingi vestibulyar belgilarda ishtirok etadi.

sources.title: Eickhoff et al. 2006 — The human parietal operculum

description.en: The insula subdivided by cell architecture into granular (Ig1–Ig3), dysgranular (Id1–Id10) and agranular (Ia1–Ia3) areas from back to front.
description.uz: Hujayra tuzilishi bo'yicha orqadan oldinga granulyar (Ig1–Ig3), disgranulyar (Id1–Id10) va agranulyar (Ia1–Ia3) maydonlarga bo'lingan insula.

role.en: Posterior granular areas map bodily sensation, pain and vestibular input; the anterior agranular areas integrate these into feelings — disgust, craving, empathy — and belong to the salience network.
role.uz: Orqa granulyar maydonlar tana sezgisi, og'riq va vestibulyar kirishni xaritalaydi; oldingi agranulyar maydonlar ularni his-tuyg'ularga — jirkanish, ishtiyoq, empatiya — birlashtiradi va salience tarmog'iga kiradi.

clinical.en: Anterior insula is a hub of addiction and anxiety; insular strokes disturb heart rhythm.
clinical.uz: Oldingi insula giyohvandlik va xavotir markazi; insula insultlari yurak ritmini buzadi.

description.en: Areas Te 1.0, Te 1.1 and Te 1.2 on Heschl's (transverse temporal) gyrus — the primary auditory cortex.
description.uz: Heshl (ko'ndalang chakka) burmasidagi Te 1.0, Te 1.1 va Te 1.2 maydonlari — birlamchi eshitish po'stlog'i.

role.en: First cortical processing of sound, arranged by frequency (tonotopy): Te 1.0 is the core.
role.uz: Tovushning birinchi po'stloq qayta ishlovi, chastota bo'yicha tartiblangan (tonotopiya): Te 1.0 — o'zak.

clinical.en: Bilateral lesions cause cortical deafness; the site of auditory hallucinations in schizophrenia.
clinical.uz: Ikki tomonlama zararlanish kortikal karlik beradi; shizofreniyada eshitish gallyutsinatsiyalari joyi.

sources.title: Morosan et al. 2001 — Human primary auditory cortex

description.en: The superior temporal gyrus areas Te 2.1, Te 2.2, Te 3, TeI, TI and TPJ (temporo-parietal junction).
description.uz: Yuqori chakka burmasining Te 2.1, Te 2.2, Te 3, TeI, TI va TPJ (chakka-tepa tutashuvi) maydonlari.

role.en: Higher auditory processing: speech sounds, voices, music; the posterior part (Wernicke's region) decodes language; the TPJ supports theory of mind and reorienting attention.
role.uz: Yuqori darajali eshitish qayta ishlovi: nutq tovushlari, ovozlar, musiqa; orqa qismi (Vernike sohasi) tilni dekodlaydi; TPJ boshqalarning fikrini tushunish va diqqatni qayta yo'naltirishni ta'minlaydi.

clinical.en: Wernicke's aphasia (left); neglect and out-of-body experiences with TPJ lesions (right).
clinical.uz: Vernike afaziyasi (chap); TPJ zararlanishida e'tiborsizlik va 'tanadan tashqarida' kechinmalar (o'ng).

description.en: Areas STS1 and STS2 in the superior temporal sulcus.
description.uz: Yuqori chakka egatidagi STS1 va STS2 maydonlari.

role.en: Perception of biological motion, faces in motion, gaze direction and voices — the social perception cortex; also audiovisual integration of speech.
role.uz: Biologik harakat, harakatdagi yuzlar, nigoh yo'nalishi va ovozlarni idrok etish — ijtimoiy idrok po'stlog'i; nutqning audiovizual integratsiyasi ham.

clinical.en: Altered function is reported in autism spectrum disorder.
clinical.uz: Autizm spektri buzilishida faoliyati o'zgarganligi qayd etilgan.

description.en: Areas FG1–FG5 of the fusiform gyrus.
description.uz: Fuziform burmaning FG1–FG5 maydonlari.

role.en: Recognition of faces (FG2/FG4, right), written words (FG2/FG4, left), bodies and objects; FG1 and FG3 are earlier visual areas.
role.uz: Yuzlar (FG2/FG4, o'ng), yozma so'zlar (FG2/FG4, chap), tanalar va narsalarni tanish; FG1 va FG3 — erta ko'rish maydonlari.

clinical.en: Prosopagnosia (right) and pure alexia (left).
clinical.uz: Prozopagnoziya (o'ng) va sof aleksiya (chap).

sources.title: Caspers et al. 2013 — Cytoarchitectonical analysis of the posterior fusiform gyrus

description.en: Area OTS1 in the occipito-temporal sulcus.
description.uz: Ensa-chakka egatidagi OTS1 maydoni.

role.en: Ventral visual stream: object and word-form recognition.
role.uz: Ventral ko'rish oqimi: narsa va so'z shaklini tanish.

clinical.en: Part of the visual word form region affected in alexia.
clinical.uz: Aleksiyada zararlanadigan ko'rish so'z shakli sohasining qismi.

description.en: Area CoS1 in the collateral sulcus, between the parahippocampal and fusiform gyri.
description.uz: Parahippokampal va fuziform burmalar orasidagi kollateral egatdagi CoS1 maydoni.

role.en: Recognition of scenes and places (with the parahippocampal place area).
role.uz: Manzara va joylarni tanish (parahippokampal joy maydoni bilan).

clinical.en: Lesions contribute to topographical disorientation.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi topografik yo'nalish buzilishiga hissa qo'shadi.

description.en: Areas Ph1–Ph3 of the posterior parahippocampal gyrus.
description.uz: Orqa parahippokampal burmaning Ph1–Ph3 maydonlari.

role.en: Scene memory and spatial context; relays visual information to the hippocampus.
role.uz: Manzara xotirasi va fazoviy kontekst; ko'rish axborotini hippokampga uzatadi.

clinical.en: Early atrophy in Alzheimer disease.
clinical.uz: Alzheimer kasalligida erta atrofiya.

description.en: The piriform (primary olfactory) cortex, temporal (PirT) and temporobasal (PirTB) parts, at the junction of the temporal pole and the uncus.
description.uz: Chakka qutbi bilan uncus tutashgan joydagi piriform (birlamchi hidlov) po'stlog'ining chakka (PirT) va chakka-bazal (PirTB) qismlari.

role.en: First cortical station for smell, directly from the olfactory bulb; links odours to memory and emotion.
role.uz: Hidlov piyozchasidan bevosita keluvchi hid uchun birinchi po'stloq bekati; hidlarni xotira va emotsiya bilan bog'laydi.

clinical.en: Olfactory auras (unpleasant smells) at the start of temporal lobe seizures originate here.
clinical.uz: Chakka tutqanoqlari boshidagi hidlov auralari (yoqimsiz hidlar) shu yerdan kelib chiqadi.

description.en: Area hOc1 — the primary visual cortex (V1, Brodmann area 17) on the banks of the calcarine sulcus, recognisable by the stria of Gennari.
description.uz: hOc1 maydoni — kalkarin egat qirg'oqlaridagi birlamchi ko'rish po'stlog'i (V1, Brodmann 17), Gennari chizig'i bilan taniladi.

role.en: The first cortical map of the opposite visual field: the upper field below the sulcus, the lower field above it, the fovea at the occipital pole with a hugely magnified area.
role.uz: Qarama-qarshi ko'rish maydonining birinchi po'stloq xaritasi: yuqori maydon egat ostida, pastki maydon ustida, fovea ensa qutbida juda kattalashtirilgan maydon bilan.

clinical.en: Lesions cause contralateral homonymous hemianopia with macular sparing (dual blood supply of the pole); bilateral damage → cortical blindness (Anton syndrome may deny it).
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi makula saqlangan qarama-qarshi gomonim gemianopsiya beradi (qutbning ikki manbali qon ta'minoti); ikki tomonlama zararlanish → kortikal ko'rlik (Anton sindromida bemor inkor qiladi).

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2000 — Brodmann's areas 17 and 18 brought into stereotaxic space

description.en: Area hOc2 — the secondary visual cortex (V2, Brodmann area 18) forming a ring around V1.
description.uz: hOc2 maydoni — V1 atrofida halqa hosil qiluvchi ikkilamchi ko'rish po'stlog'i (V2, Brodmann 18).

role.en: Refines V1 output: contours, illusory edges, binocular depth and colour, and sends it on to the dorsal and ventral streams.
role.uz: V1 chiqishini takomillashtiradi: konturlar, illyuzor qirralar, binokulyar chuqurlik va rang; so'ng dorsal va ventral oqimlarga uzatadi.

clinical.en: Usually damaged together with V1 in occipital strokes.
clinical.uz: Odatda ensa insultlarida V1 bilan birga zararlanadi.

description.en: Areas hOc3d and hOc4d (dorsal V3/V3A) on the cuneus above the calcarine sulcus.
description.uz: Kalkarin egat ustidagi cuneusdagi hOc3d va hOc4d (dorsal V3/V3A) maydonlari.

role.en: Dorsal-stream processing of the lower visual field: motion and spatial position.
role.uz: Pastki ko'rish maydonining dorsal oqim qayta ishlovi: harakat va fazoviy holat.

clinical.en: Lesions produce a lower quadrantanopia on the opposite side.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi qarama-qarshi tomonda pastki kvadrantanopsiya beradi.

sources.title: Rottschy et al. 2007 — Ventral visual cortex in humans

description.en: Areas hOc3v and hOc4v (ventral V3 and V4) on the lingual gyrus below the calcarine sulcus.
description.uz: Kalkarin egat ostidagi lingual burmadagi hOc3v va hOc4v (ventral V3 va V4) maydonlari.

role.en: Ventral-stream processing of the upper visual field, especially colour (V4) and form.
role.uz: Yuqori ko'rish maydonining ventral oqim qayta ishlovi, ayniqsa rang (V4) va shakl.

clinical.en: Lesions cause an upper quadrantanopia; bilateral V4 damage → achromatopsia.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi yuqori kvadrantanopsiya beradi; ikki tomonlama V4 zararlanishi → axromatopsiya.

sources.title: Rottschy et al. 2007 — Ventral visual cortex in humans

description.en: Areas hOc4la, hOc4lp and hOc5 in the lateral occipital cortex.
description.uz: Lateral ensa po'stlog'idagi hOc4la, hOc4lp va hOc5 maydonlari.

role.en: hOc4la/lp recognise object shape (lateral occipital complex); hOc5 is V5/MT, the motion area.
role.uz: hOc4la/lp narsa shaklini taniydi (lateral ensa kompleksi); hOc5 — V5/MT, harakat maydoni.

clinical.en: V5 lesions cause akinetopsia; lateral occipital damage causes visual form agnosia.
clinical.uz: V5 zararlanishi akinetopsiya, lateral ensa zararlanishi ko'rish shakl agnoziyasini beradi.

sources.title: Malikovic et al. 2007 — Cytoarchitectonic analysis of area hOc5 (V5/MT+)

description.en: Areas hOc6 and hPO1 in the parieto-occipital sulcus (V6 / V6A).
description.uz: Tepa-ensa egatidagi hOc6 va hPO1 maydonlari (V6 / V6A).

role.en: Analysis of optic flow during self-motion and visual guidance of reaching.
role.uz: O'z harakati vaqtida optik oqim tahlili va qo'l uzatishni ko'rish orqali boshqarish.

clinical.en: Part of the dorsal stream involved in optic ataxia.
clinical.uz: Optik ataksiyada ishtirok etuvchi dorsal oqimning qismi.

description.en: Areas Fo1–Fo7 of the orbitofrontal cortex on the orbital surface of the frontal lobe.
description.uz: Peshona bo'lagi orbital yuzasidagi orbitofrontal po'stloqning Fo1–Fo7 maydonlari.

role.en: Assigning value to rewards and punishments, flavour and smell, and flexible decision making.
role.uz: Mukofot va jazoga, ta'm va hidga qiymat berish hamda moslashuvchan qaror qabul qilish.

clinical.en: Damage causes disinhibition and poor judgement; involved in OCD, depression and addiction.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi tormozsizlik va mulohaza buzilishini beradi; OKB, depressiya va giyohvandlikda ishtirok etadi.

description.en: Areas Fp1 and Fp2 of the frontal pole (Brodmann area 10) — the most anterior cortex, proportionally largest in humans.
description.uz: Peshona qutbining Fp1 va Fp2 maydonlari (Brodmann 10) — eng oldingi po'stloq, odamda nisbatan eng katta.

role.en: Holding goals in mind while doing something else (multitasking), prospective memory and reasoning about one's own thoughts.
role.uz: Boshqa ish qilayotganda maqsadni yodda tutish (multitasking), kelajakka mo'ljallangan xotira va o'z fikrlari haqida mulohaza yuritish.

clinical.en: Lesions impair planning of complex, multi-step tasks.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi murakkab, ko'p bosqichli vazifalarni rejalashtirishni buzadi.

sources.title: Bludau et al. 2014 — Cytoarchitecture of the human frontal pole

description.en: Area 33 of the anterior cingulate cortex, in the callosal sulcus.
description.uz: Kallozal egatdagi oldingi singulyat po'stloqning 33-maydoni.

role.en: Part of the limbic anterior cingulate: emotion and autonomic regulation.
role.uz: Limbik oldingi singulyatning qismi: emotsiya va vegetativ boshqaruv.

clinical.en: Involved in mood disorders.
clinical.uz: Kayfiyat buzilishlarida ishtirok etadi.

sources.title: Palomero-Gallagher et al. 2008 — Cytology and receptor architecture of human anterior cingulate cortex

description.en: Pregenual anterior cingulate areas p24ab, p24c and p32, in front of the genu of the corpus callosum.
description.uz: Qadoq tana tizzasi oldidagi pregenual oldingi singulyat p24ab, p24c va p32 maydonlari.

role.en: Emotional regulation, empathy and the affective aspect of pain; a hub of the default-mode network.
role.uz: Emotsional boshqaruv, empatiya va og'riqning affektiv jihati; default-mode tarmog'i markazi.

clinical.en: Hypoactive in depression; cingulotomy here treats intractable pain and OCD.
clinical.uz: Depressiyada gipofaol; bu yerda singulotomiya davolab bo'lmas og'riq va OKBni davolaydi.

description.en: Subgenual anterior cingulate areas 25, s24 and s32, under the genu of the corpus callosum.
description.uz: Qadoq tana tizzasi ostidagi subgenual oldingi singulyat 25, s24 va s32 maydonlari.

role.en: Regulates mood, autonomic and endocrine responses to emotion.
role.uz: Emotsiyaga kayfiyat, vegetativ va endokrin javoblarni boshqaradi.

clinical.en: Area 25 is overactive in treatment-resistant depression and the target of DBS for it.
clinical.uz: 25-maydon davolashga chidamli depressiyada giperfaol va u uchun DBS nishoni.

description.en: Area 6mp — the supplementary motor area (SMA) on the medial superior frontal gyrus, in front of the leg area of the motor cortex.
description.uz: 6mp maydoni — medial yuqori peshona burmasidagi qo'shimcha harakat maydoni (SMA), harakat po'stlog'i oyoq sohasi oldida.

role.en: Plans and initiates internally generated movement sequences and bimanual coordination; active before a movement is felt as 'willed'.
role.uz: Ichki hosil qilingan harakat ketma-ketliklari va ikki qo'l muvofiqligini rejalashtiradi va boshlaydi; harakat 'irodaviy' deb his qilinishidan oldin faol.

clinical.en: SMA syndrome after surgery: transient contralateral akinesia and mutism that recovers over weeks; SMA seizures cause the 'fencing posture'.
clinical.uz: Jarrohlikdan keyingi SMA sindromi: haftalar davomida tiklanadigan o'tkinchi qarama-qarshi akineziya va mutizm; SMA tutqanoqlari 'qilichboz holati'ni beradi.

description.en: Area 6ma — the pre-supplementary motor area (pre-SMA), in front of the SMA.
description.uz: 6ma maydoni — SMA oldidagi pre-qo'shimcha harakat maydoni (pre-SMA).

role.en: Cognitive control of action: stopping, switching and choosing between responses.
role.uz: Harakatning kognitiv nazorati: to'xtatish, almashtirish va javoblar orasida tanlash.

clinical.en: Involved in speech initiation; lesions cause transient mutism.
clinical.uz: Nutqni boshlashda ishtirok etadi; zararlanishi o'tkinchi mutizm beradi.

description.en: 'GapMaps' are the parts of the cortex that Julich-Brain has not yet mapped at the level of individual areas — large frontal, temporal and parietal territories drawn as single provisional regions until their cytoarchitecture is published.
description.uz: 'GapMap'lar — Julich-Brain hali alohida maydonlar darajasida xaritalamagan po'stloq qismlari; sitoarxitektonikasi e'lon qilingunga qadar bitta vaqtinchalik soha sifatida chizilgan katta peshona, chakka va tepa hududlari.

role.en: Association cortex: the frontal GapMaps cover prefrontal planning and social cognition, the temporal ones semantic memory, the parietal ones attention.
role.uz: Assotsiativ po'stloq: peshona GapMap'lari prefrontal rejalashtirish va ijtimoiy kognitsiyani, chakkadagilari semantik xotirani, tepadagilari diqqatni qamrab oladi.

clinical.en: For clinical anatomy of these regions consult the gross gyrus or the Brodmann/Glasser layers.
clinical.uz: Bu sohalarning klinik anatomiyasi uchun gross gyrus yoki Brodmann/Glasser qatlamlariga qarang.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture
